title: Volume Ray Casting quality estimation in terms of Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio
abstract: In spite of a large number of techniques aimed for improvement of Direct Volume Rendering (DVR) quality and performance proposed in the literature, there is a lack of approaches for numerical quality estimation of the images obtained by visualization of medical and scientific volumetric datasets. In this paper we propose a method to estimate sampling artefacts. Using the proposed estimation method we compare different RC algorithms to expose optimal ones in quality-performance criteria.

cited_by.name: PSNR-based Quality Estimation for Ray Casting
